entities.summary: Hasan bey Agalarov was a Russian military leader of Azerbaijani origin who reached the rank of lieutenant general in the Imperial Russian Army. He became the first Azerbaijani to be awarded the Order of St. George in the course of hostilities after he distinguished himself in the battle of Debrecen on 21 July 1849 during the suppression of the Hungarian uprising of 1848-1849).
